subject: Post-demo: procurement path options, marketplace interest, and SOC 2 gating
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Jenna Park <jenna.park@acme-corp.com>, Ops Team <ops@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Follow-up & next steps after today's demo - procurement options + SOC 2 asks

Hi Jenna / Acme ops team,

Thanks again for your time this morning — really appreciated the clear signals on performance SLAs and the procurement path constraints. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

- Procurement options you mentioned: PO (preferred by finance), corporate card for pilot, or marketplace listing if you want to buy quickly and defer SOW/legal negotiation.
- Security gating items called out: SOC 2 report (Type II preferred), executed DPA, and the completed security questionnaire. You also mentioned an internal review of data residency but that looks optional for the initial pilot.

Attachments: I attached a one-pager with the commercial options and a short SOC 2 summary for Redwood to speed your review.

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) Jenna / legal: confirm whether PO route requires a specific Redwood billing entity and whether a PO needs a pre-signed SOW.
2) Ops: confirm pilot payment method (card vs PO) for the initial 3-month sandbox.
3) Internal (Aditya/Marissa): I'll loop you in for pricing alignment and to propose an MLP (mutual action plan) with dates.

If it helps, we can also accelerate a marketplace listing to let you start with a corporate card while the PO/DPA are finalized — takes ~3 business days to enable from our side.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai
Attachments: SOC2-Report-Redwood-summary.pdf (summary), Redwood-Commercial-Options-1pager.pdf (pricing & paths)

From: Jenna Park <jenna.park@acme-corp.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ops Team <ops@acme-corp.com>
Date: 2026-12-20T11:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up & next steps after today's demo - procurement options + SOC 2 asks

Thanks, Kimberly — good summary. A few clarifications from Legal and Procurement: 

- Procurement preference: Our Procurement partner prefers PO for any multi-month commitment. For an initial sandbox we can accept a corporate card, but Finance will likely require a PO once spend exceeds $25k/month.
- DPA: we will need an executed DPA before production access. Please send your standard DPA template and confirm Redwood's point of contact for legal redlines.
- SOC 2: we need the SOC 2 Type II report. The summary you sent is helpful, but we will require the auditor attestation to close the security review.
- Security questionnaire: I'll attach our standard vendor security questionnaire. Please have your InfoSec team complete and return. Expect turnaround time ~5 business days once completed.

Also, can you confirm whether logging/audit retention options meet our 13-month retention requirement? That's a hard requirement for the pilot if any customer data is sent.

I'll attach the questionnaire (ACME-Security-Questionnaire.xlsx) and a short procurement intake form.

Jenna Park
Senior Counsel, Acme Corp
jenna.park@acme-corp.com
Attachments: ACME-Security-Questionnaire.xlsx

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-20T11:20:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Follow-up & next steps after today's demo - Acme asks (PO / SOC 2 / questionnaire)

Aditya / Marissa — forwarding Jenna's note. Key asks: SOC 2 Type II report (auditor attestation), completed security questionnaire, executed DPA before production, PO expected for multi-month commitments, 13-month audit log retention requirement.

Can we:
- Marissa: confirm whether we can surface the full SOC 2 attestation and who owns redaction if required (we typically provide a customer-safe report).
- Aditya: recommend a procurement path and whether we should propose marketplace-first pilot (card) + PO at renewal, or push for PO upfront. Also advise on any promotional credits if marketplace vs PO causes friction.

I'll propose a short MAP doc once you confirm the ask items.

Thanks,
Kimberly

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-20T13:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Acme procurement asks — proposed commercial path

Thanks for the flag, Kim. Quick thoughts: 

- Marketplace-first pilot (card) is low friction and keeps procurement happy for an initial 60–90 day eval. Recommend we propose a 3-month paid pilot on the marketplace and include explicit “conversion terms” into a PO for production. That gives Acme time to complete legal while we get usage/ops data.
- SOC 2: we can provide a customer-safe SOC 2 Type II package; I'll confirm exact artefacts with InfoSec. We typically share the auditor attestation under an NDA / secure portal.
- DPA: I'll loop Legal to push an editable DPA for Jenna to redline.
- Credits: propose offering a $5k credit if they commit to PO conversion within 90 days (discounted unit price thereafter). Helps offset procurement friction and is a common closing lever.

I'll draft an MAP and include milestone dates: questionnaire return (5 business days), SOC 2 artefact delivery (2 business days after NDA), pilot enablement via marketplace (3 business days), PO signed (TBD).

Aditya
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachments proposed: SOW-draft.docx (stated for PO path)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-21T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Acme procurement asks — SOC 2 artefacts + MAP

Looping in a couple items from Prod Ops and InfoSec: 

- SOC 2 artefacts: InfoSec confirms we can provide the SOC 2 Type II report and auditor attestation through our secure portal. We will watermark the copy and restrict download; legal can request redactions if needed.
- Logging retention: our default audit logs are 12 months. For 13-month retention we can configure export retention to meet their requirement (requires a short ops config and will be scoped in SOW).
- Marketplace enablement: Ops notes we can enable Acme's account on the marketplace within 72 hours; finance will accept card payments there.

I'll update the MAP to include these operational acceptance criteria and include the SOW-draft.docx as the starting PO/SOW artifact.

Marissa
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Jenna Park <jenna.park@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-21T14:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: procurement path options, marketplace interest, and SOC 2 gating — proposed MAP + next meeting

Jenna — thanks for the quick turnaround. Per internal alignment we can deliver: 

1) SOC 2 Type II package via secure portal (will send NDA link and portal access within 24 hours).
2) Editable DPA for your legal redlines (Aditya will share).
3) Marketplace-first pilot to kick off on corporate card within 3 business days, while we work PO + SOW for production.
4) Ops will configure 13-month export retention for the pilot if customer data is in scope.

Proposed next step: 30-minute cadence call on Thursday 12/23 at 10am PT to confirm procurement path and checklist. If that works, I'll send a calendar invite and the draft MAP (includes milestones and dates).

Thanks — looking forward to closing this out.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai
